title: Multiple data centers
purpose: Separate geographic DNS endpoint selection from direct regional HTTP routing and illustrate regional DB/cache plus sharedstorage with data synchronization caveats.
alt: 지리 기반 DNS 주소 선택, 지역별 로드밸런서·서버·DB·캐시 및 지역 간 데이터 동기화
requiredChecks: GeoDNS exchanges DNS query/selected regional endpoint with Client, while HTTP connects Client directly to regional load balancer, not through DNS.
Two data-center boundaries each contain local Load balancer→Web servers and local DB/Cache.
Regional DBs have a dashed data synchronization link with policy-dependent qualification; both regional web tiers access external Shared storage.
CDN serves client static assets separately; failover caption acknowledges health checks and DNS caching.
